label: Cuenta de valores (listed shares)
Spanien 2025: en homogen anskaffningspos: Spain 2025: one homogeneous acquisition lot of listed shares. Withdrawals sell proportionally from this single lot, equivalent to FIFO for the lot. Share gains and dividends/interest are separate savings-base categories with up to 25% cross-offset and four-year loss carryforward. Reinvestment/traspasos do not defer tax for ETFs or shares; qualifying fund switches are excluded. Tax is calculated on the owner’s total savings base, not as a flat account tax.
Faktisk anskaffningsdag / första insättn: Actual acquisition date / first deposit date
Förluster är avdragsgilla: verifierat in: Losses are deductible: verified no repurchase of the same listed shares within two months, or provider confirmation of deductibility
Ange faktisk anskaffningsdag för den end: Enter the actual acquisition date for the single share lot.
